DESCRIPTION: A Sennheiser Digital 6000 receiver, an EM 6000 or EM 6000 Dante, over the Sound Control Protocol on UDP 45: each channel's mute, carrier, name and warnings, its pack's name, gain and battery, the device's own, and the meters of both channels.

SOURCES: Sennheiser, Sound Control Protocol (SSC), Developer's guide for Digital 6000 (EM 6000, L 6000), TI 1109 v2.2: the EM 6000 method list (8.1 to 8.104), /mm's metering array and its subscription example
cross-read, not copied: bitfocus/companion-module-sennheiser-digital6000 (MIT), its help page: the actions, feedbacks and variables per device

carrier.DESCRIPTION: The carrier frequency in kHz, 470100 to 713900 in steps of 25 (8.17).

identify.DESCRIPTION: Asked, the receiver shows Identified and blinks; answers true (8.41).

testtone.DESCRIPTION: The test tone: -60 to 0 dBFS on, 1 off (8.43).

active_warnings.DESCRIPTION: The warnings now: RFPeak, AFPeak, LowSignal, NoLink, LowBattery, BadClock, NoClock, Aes256Error, AnTxYBNCShorted (8.46).

active_status.DESCRIPTION: The status and its substatus: SyncOK, SyncFail, Identified, SwUpdatePass, SwUpdateFail (8.47).

type.DESCRIPTION: The pack: its type and the lowest and highest of its range (8.20).

name.DESCRIPTION: The pack's name; empty with none (8.21).

gain.DESCRIPTION: The pack's gain as it words it, "42 dB"; empty with none (8.23).

battery.DESCRIPTION: The pack's battery: a state - 100%, 70%, 30% or low - and the time left, x:xx or -:--; empty with none (8.27).

mm.DESCRIPTION: The meters of both channels, nine each: RF1, RF1 peak, RF2, RF2 peak, diversity 1, diversity 2, link quality (255 best), AF, AF peak - raw: dBm is (value - 255) / 2, dBFS (value + 1) / 2 - 128 (8.100).
